complaint.name: App Stability & Crashes
complaint.definition: Covers general app crashes, freezing, unresponsiveness, and stability issues across all platforms. Excludes specific performance lag or platform-specific bugs.

complaint.name: Performance & Loading Speed
complaint.definition: Covers slow loading times, lag, sluggish responsiveness, and general performance degradation. Excludes crashes or freezing.

complaint.name: iPad Specific Issues
complaint.definition: Covers stability, functionality, usability, and hardware integration (Apple Pencil, Magic Keyboard) issues specific to the iPad platform. Excludes general iOS/iPhone issues.

complaint.name: Mobile iOS Experience
complaint.definition: Covers stability, functionality, usability, and performance issues specific to the iPhone/iOS mobile app. Excludes iPad-specific issues and general web/desktop issues.

complaint.name: AI Features & Pricing
complaint.definition: Covers complaints about AI feature availability, forced integration, pricing, credit limits, and specific AI tool functionality. Excludes general app stability.

complaint.name: UI/UX & Usability
complaint.definition: Covers user interface design, navigation, intuitiveness, complexity, and general ease of use. Excludes specific feature bugs or performance issues.

complaint.name: Learning Curve & Onboarding
complaint.definition: Covers the difficulty of learning the app, steep learning curves, and the initial onboarding experience. Excludes general usability or feature requests.

complaint.name: Data Sync & Offline Access
complaint.definition: Covers issues with data synchronization between devices, offline mode availability, and data loss. Excludes general app stability.

complaint.name: Pricing & Subscriptions
complaint.definition: Covers subscription costs, paywalls, price increases, cancellation processes, and refund policies. Excludes AI-specific pricing.

complaint.name: Account & Authentication
complaint.definition: Covers login processes, sign-in issues, password resets, and account access problems. Excludes general app stability.

complaint.name: Updates & Compatibility
complaint.definition: Covers issues related to app updates, forced updates, OS version requirements, and device compatibility. Excludes general app stability.

complaint.name: Typing & Text Editing
complaint.definition: Covers issues with the typing experience, text selection, deletion, formatting, and specific text-related bugs. Excludes general UI/UX.

complaint.name: Customer Support
complaint.definition: Covers the quality, responsiveness, and availability of customer support services. Excludes AI customer support bots if they are part of the AI feature set, but generally includes human support complaints.

complaint.name: Feature Functionality Gaps
complaint.definition: Covers missing features, specific functional bugs in non-core areas (like images, videos, databases), and feature bloat. Excludes general stability or UI/UX.

praise.name: Core Organization & Structure
praise.definition: Fundamental capabilities for structuring, categorizing, and managing information, notes, and projects. Includes databases, hierarchies, and general 'second brain' functionality. Excludes specific use-case versatility or AI-driven organization.

praise.name: Versatility & Use Cases
praise.definition: The breadth of scenarios in which the app can be used, from personal life to business, education, and creative projects. Focuses on the 'all-in-one' nature and adaptability to different workflows. Excludes specific feature mechanics like databases or AI.

praise.name: AI Features & Integration
praise.definition: Capabilities related to artificial intelligence, including built-in AI tools, integrations with external LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.), and AI-driven assistance. Excludes general automation or non-AI integrations.

praise.name: Customization & Templates
praise.definition: User control over the appearance, layout, and structure of their workspace, including the use of pre-made templates and the ability to modify them. Excludes general ease of use or performance.

praise.name: Pricing & Free Tier
praise.definition: Perceptions of the app's cost, value proposition, and the limitations or benefits of the free version versus paid plans. Excludes general feature availability unless tied to cost.

praise.name: Platform Performance & Stability
praise.definition: Technical reliability, speed, and stability of the application across different devices (iOS, Android, Desktop, Web). Includes crashes, lag, sync issues, and general app health. Excludes UI design or feature requests.

praise.name: UI/UX & Ease of Use
praise.definition: The user interface design, navigation, intuitiveness, and overall learning curve. Focuses on how easy or difficult it is to interact with the app. Excludes specific feature capabilities or performance speed.

praise.name: Support & Community
praise.definition: Quality of customer service, responsiveness of support teams, and the value of community resources like tutorials, forums, and user-generated content. Excludes in-app help features unless they are part of the broader support ecosystem.
